data.title: 佐天泪子 · 河堤斜阳下的微风单车
data.description: 放学后微风轻拂的学园都市河堤斜坡，金黄落日将水面映得波光粼粼。泪子单腿支着自行车踏板，拉开运动风衣拉链，内衬贴身背心显露出匀称健美的身材与光洁锁骨。微风扬起她的长发，少女向你递来一罐微凉的运动饮料，笑容飒爽而带着几分羞赧。
data.location: grassy riverbank slope with asphalt cycling path during golden hour
data.action: leaning against bicycle on riverbank at sunset, casual jacket unzipped over athletic tank top, offering cold drink, radiant blushing smile
data.lighting: glorious golden hour sunset casting warm long shadows on grass and river
data.mood: youthful refreshing vitality, heartwarming school-days intimacy
data.promptProse: Leaning on her bicycle along a grassy riverbank at golden sunset, Ruiko Saten unzips her sporty parka over an athletic top. She offers a cold canned drink with a breezy, affectionate smile as wind catches her hair.
data.animaCaption: Ruiko leaning on her bicycle at sunset on a riverbank, offering a drink with a bright smile.
